faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Voca.

items.question: Is Voca free?
answer: Yes, Voca is completely free. No plans, no card. Download it and every feature is yours.
It's also open source, so you can read every line of code yourself.

items.question: Do I need to pay or add a card?
answer: No. You sign in with Google and start talking.
We don't ask for a card or any payment details.

items.question: What makes Voca different?
answer: Background noise cancellation built for real-world environments — especially useful for developers in noisy spaces.
AI that recognizes function names, code terms, and technical jargon, then transcribes them correctly instead of guessing.
Smart auto-paste: the corrected transcript lands right where your cursor was. No copy-paste, no switching apps.
AI doesn't just transcribe — it improves your writing style, fixes grammar, and makes your text cleaner than what you actually said.

items.question: What is Developer Mode?
answer: Developer Mode is a tone setting built specifically for software engineers. When enabled, Voca's AI recognizes code terms, function names, library names, and technical jargon — and transcribes them correctly instead of treating them as regular words.
Say "reakt use state hook" and it writes "React useState hook". Say "nahbar component" and it writes "navbar component".
Combined with background noise cancellation, it's designed for developers who dictate code comments, documentation, or messages while working in real-world environments.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
answer: 35+ languages for speech recognition through Deepgram and Groq engines.
100+ languages for AI-powered translation with tone control — formal, casual, or developer mode.
Developer mode automatically recognizes code terms and technical jargon, keeping them in English while translating the rest naturally.

items.question: Where is my data stored?
answer: Your data is processed on our servers with a privacy-first approach. Voca is fully open source — you can inspect every line of code yourself.
Don't want your transcripts stored on our servers? Turn on Privacy Mode in Settings. Each transcript is then shown once and never saved. It's entirely your choice.
We don't sell your data and we don't show ads. The app has no analytics. The website uses Google Analytics for visit statistics, as explained in our Privacy Policy.

items.question: Does it work offline?
answer: Voca requires an internet connection. Your audio is sent to our servers where we process it for the best possible quality at the lowest cost.
Our cloud pipeline includes background noise cancellation, AI correction, code-aware transcription, and smart translation — delivering faster, more accurate results than any local solution could.

items.question: Will new features be added?
answer: Absolutely. Voca is an actively developed platform. We ship updates regularly with new features, improvements, and optimizations.
Your feedback directly shapes the roadmap. Found a bug or have a feature request? Reach out through email or social links in the footer, we read everything.

intro.heading: 1. Introduction
intro.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Voca ("Service"), operated by Emircan Sahin ("we", "us", "our"), collects, uses, and protects your information when you visit usevoca.dev or use the Voca desktop app.

website.heading: 2. Our Website
website.content: The usevoca.dev website uses Google Analytics to show us how visitors use it. Google Analytics sets cookies and collects usage statistics such as the pages you visit, your approximate location, and your device and browser type. We look at these statistics in aggregate to improve the website. We don't use them for advertising, and they are not linked to your Voca account.
website.optOut: You can block Google Analytics through your browser's cookie settings, a content blocker extension, or Google's <optOut>opt-out browser add-on</optOut>. The website works the same without it. The desktop app does not use Google Analytics or any other analytics.

collection.heading: 3. Information We Collect in the App
collection.intro: You sign in to the desktop app with your Google account. We store:
items: Account details: your name, email address, profile picture URL, and Google account ID. We use them to sign you in and identify your account.
App settings: your preferences, such as your speech-to-text provider, languages, and translation options.
Custom vocabulary: the words you add so transcription gets your names and terms right.

audio.heading: 4. Audio Recordings
items: Voca records audio only while you hold or toggle your recording shortcut. It never listens in the background.
Your recording is uploaded to our server over an encrypted HTTPS connection and sent to the speech-to-text provider you picked in Settings (Groq or Deepgram).
We delete the audio file from our server immediately after transcription, whether it succeeds or fails. We keep no copy of your recordings.

translation.heading: 5. Translation and Tone
translation.content: If you turn on translation in the app, the transcribed text is sent to DeepSeek, a provider based in China, to translate it and apply your selected tone and add-ons. DeepSeek only receives text, never your audio.

transcripts.heading: 6. Transcripts and Privacy Mode
transcripts.content: By default, your transcripts are stored in our database so they appear in your History. You can delete any transcript at any time.
transcripts.privacyMode: Privacy Mode (in the app's Settings): while it's on, your transcripts are never saved on our servers. Each result is shown to you once and is gone when you close the app. Turning Privacy Mode on also deletes all of your existing transcripts.

logs.heading: 7. Logs
logs.content: Our server keeps operational logs so we can run the Service and fix problems. They contain errors and request metadata such as audio duration, language, and processing cost. Logs never contain your audio or the text of your transcripts.

thirdParty.heading: 8. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: We work with the following providers to run Voca. Each one processes data under its own privacy policy:

items.google: Google: sign-in for the app and analytics for the website. Privacy Policy
items.groq: Groq: speech-to-text. Receives your audio when Groq is your selected provider. Privacy Policy
items.deepgram: Deepgram: speech-to-text. Receives your audio when Deepgram is your selected provider. Privacy Policy
items.deepseek: DeepSeek: translation, tone, and add-ons. Based in China. Receives your transcript text when translation is on. Privacy Policy
items.paddle: Paddle: payment processing for paid plans. Voca is currently free, so Paddle only receives data if paid plans are introduced and you choose to subscribe. Privacy Policy
items.hosting: Hosting and database providers: run our servers and store your account data and transcripts on our behalf.

noCollect.heading: 9. What We Don't Do
items: We don't sell or rent your personal data.
We don't show ads or use your data for advertising.
We don't keep copies of your audio recordings.

retention.heading: 10. Data Retention
items: Audio: deleted from our server immediately after transcription.
Transcripts: kept until you delete them. Never stored while Privacy Mode is on.
Account, settings, and vocabulary: kept while your account is active. Contact us to request deletion.

rights.heading: 11. Your Rights
items: Access your transcripts and settings in the app.
Delete individual transcripts at any time, or all of them by turning on Privacy Mode.
Request a copy or full deletion of your account data by contacting us.

children.heading: 12. Children's Privacy
children.content: The Service is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.heading: 13. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The date at the top shows the latest version. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.heading: 14. Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at <email>contact@usevoca.dev</email>.

trial.heading: 1. Free Month
trial.content: All new accounts automatically receive the first month free — $3 in credits, fully featured, no credit card required. No action needed at sign up. After the free month, you can choose a plan to continue.

cancellation.heading: 2. Cancellation
cancellation.content: You may cancel your subscription at any time. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period, and the next month simply won't renew. No cancellation fees apply.

refunds.heading: 3. Refunds
refunds.content: Payments are processed by Paddle, our Merchant of Record. If you believe you were charged in error or would like to request a refund, please contact Paddle directly through their <paddleHelp>help center</paddleHelp>.

credits.heading: 4. Credits
credits.content: Monthly credits are non-transferable and do not roll over to the next billing period. Unused credits are not eligible for refunds.

contact.heading: 5. Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about this Refund Policy, contact us at <email>contact@usevoca.dev</email>.
